source.name: Crystal Palace FC: Crystal Palace Women announce TEN Ltd as new shirt sleeve sponsor
source.quote: TST Foundation and its affiliated NYSE-listed energy transport company TEN Ltd will continue their partnership with the Club, with TEN becoming the team’s official shirt sleeve sponsor.
source.note: The same announcement says the deal 'follows TEN’s successful spell as Crystal Palace Women’s front-of-shirt sponsor' and puts the logo 'on the sleeve of the home, away and third kits'; no value reported.

note: Sleeve sponsorship of Crystal Palace Women from 2026/27, after a spell as the women's front-of-shirt sponsor; the company calls it its third consecutive season sponsoring Crystal Palace. No deal value reported.
